subject.description: Published main baseline: the 32-obligation docs/RESULTS.md on main, generated from a snapshot of c175fbd
subject.source_digest_definition: SHA-256 over every *.py file under assurance_lab/, sorted by relative path components, each fed as posix relative path + NUL + file bytes + NUL (the definition of digest_entries/source_digest in assurance_lab/provenance.py at the subject commit)
subject.expected_targets_definition: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8) of the list of [obligation, verdict label] pairs of the baseline report's Claims table, in report order

claims_note: Verdict labels and result values are withheld from this package (P1-02). They are committed by expected_targets_sha256 and read only by reconcile.py, after the sealed evidence has passed integrity and identity checks.

residual_assumptions_of_the_baseline: BoundaryCompleteness: every covered authority relation is represented in the model
Logical actions are atomic at the invariant's abstraction level
Python interpreter and this checker are correct (no independent proof checker)
finite domain only; no unbounded/parameterized proof
Safety is encoded; its adequacy vs. the informal principle is a judgment
NOT linearizability, consensus, or arbitrary partitions
replicas may serve a stale head before delivery
resolution policy authorities are themselves trustworthy
a replica may act on the eventual loser before learning of the fork
no message loss, crashes, or Byzantine replicas modeled
outcomes checked only for the scripted scenarios
excluded: the development branch (PR #2) and its later reports
the TLA+ artifacts, which have never been run under SANY/TLC
the handoff's v3 model and its counts, which are not in this repository
run-dependent metadata (timestamps, durations, interpreter version, run id, receipt id)
commands_note: 'python' means the reproduction interpreter (a fresh venv by default). pytest is unpinned, as in the frozen roadmap package; the installed version is recorded in environment.json (pip_freeze). The quick campaign has no published target; it is run and recorded, and a nonzero exit counts.
